annotations.title: Prepare an order the customer confirms by email

description: Prepares an order of this configured watch for the user, with the name, email and delivery address the user agreed to share with B.R.M (user_consent=true). B.R.M emails the user a summary with a 'Confirm my order' button (link valid 72 h); there the user chooses card, interest-free instalments (Alma under EUR 2,000, Pledg from EUR 2,000, where available), a 20% deposit (watch from EUR 3,000) or bank transfer (EUR only), and pays B.R.M on B.R.M's secure payment page. The price is computed by B.R.M for the delivery country (currency and VAT follow the delivery country). Returns order_id, status 'awaiting_customer_confirmation', and message_for_user (a summary for the user). The order is not placed until the user confirms from the email; the tool takes no payment details and returns no delivery date. Limited to a few orders per day per email; an idempotency_key makes retries safe.

engraving.description: Optional engraving text (not priced, not rendered).

options.description: option_id values from describe_model. Unset components keep their default.

name: create_order

is_order.description: Always false here: the order exists only after the user's confirmation.

lead_time.description: No firm number of weeks is given by this API: show `url` (the delivery page of brm-chronographes.com, in the user's language) for lead times.
